problemStatement: Candidate v0.4 has an irreducible near-domain false-activation floor because some explicit modern informational/documentation/accounting questions are not represented as unsupported targets. They can therefore become confirmed strong Arbitration routes and bypass Scope. A Scope cutoff cannot repair an upstream semantic-target error.
principles: Repair the earliest incorrect semantic target representation instead of weakening Scope safety constraints.
Modern informational, documentation, procedural, administrative and accounting questions are not current supported divination outcome targets merely because they mention a current-22 domain entity.
A real supported current outcome target continues to outrank incidental mentions of fees, rules, administration or documentation.
Do not remove confirmed-strong Scope bypass merely to fit calibration data; make its precondition semantically valid instead.
Do not change Router, Routeability learned weights, Identity learned heads, Fallback Acceptance thresholds, route inventory, health Policy Gate or traditional LiuYao observation selection.
No route-specific threshold or phrase-specific exception may be introduced.

evidence.responsibility: Generalize explicit unsupported information-seeking target extraction without changing supported route semantics.
requiredCoverage: questions asking how duties/responsibilities/division of work/agreement wording should be written or arranged
questions asking how receivables aging/accounting categories/ledger classification should be classified, recorded or calculated
generic how-to/template/classification wording when the question target is information rather than a supported outcome
mustNot: block an actual supported outcome merely because documentation, fees, tax or accounting is mentioned as background
infer traditional 六亲, 世应 or 用神
encode SC2 row ids or exact calibration sentences as runtime exceptions

arbitration.responsibility: Use Evidence v0.4 as the default extractor while preserving v0.12 routing semantics when supplied evidence is unchanged.

compatibility.policy: any explicit unsupportedTargets contradict current-22 activation
